blurb: Dance 10 was founded in 1986 with the hopes and dreams of creating a studio that not only taught proper dance training and technique but helped to create strong, confident young people. The studio started in the American Legion in September of 1986 with a grand total of 35 students our first year. Over the years, the studio has grown and continues to grow at our home on 5 Hillcrest
